entries.title: The menus stop dropping frames
entries.hook: The planned fix was thrown out by the measurement that was supposed to justify it.

citations.subject: feat(gs): PS2X_GS_UPLOAD_TRACE -- the upload path's cost split per term; the measurement that stopped Goal 2's batching (Sprint 8 Goal 2 Task 1, R108)

docs: Goal 2 stopped by its own measurement (R108) -- the menus' cost is the shadow swizzle (42 of 59 ms/s) and executeTransfer (157-203 ms/s), not per-call overhead: the GL side already uploads 31 whole bands a second
perf(gs): cached textures revalidate by a hash of the bytes their decode read -- the menus stop re-decoding the whole cache every frame (Sprint 8 Goal 2b, R123)
docs: Goal 2b closed on the symptom (R125) -- the login screen holds 58-60 fps under a four-core load with no back-pressure waiter; voice as far as it goes this sprint

entries.title: It can save, and it can hear you
entries.hook: Two things every finished game has, and this one didn't.

fix(voice): the headset's status word -- the game opens it when a session starts; the voice format honoured; a pad-overlay probe and a WAV reference for the harness (Sprint 8 Goal 3 Task 3)

entries.title: The launcher gets a face

entries.title: A server of its own, on the internet

entries.title: It says why it won't start, and it weighs less
entries.hook: A new sprint with one narrow question: what happens to somebody who has never seen this before.

citations.subject: feat: the exit-code taxonomy in one header -- 65 kept, 66-72 added, 1 and 3 named, native crash statuses classified as 70 (R127, R128); the launcher's sentence is a lookup and Python reads the same table
feat(runner): a failure explains itself -- a preflight before the window opens (66/67/68/72), the bare run from config.json (69), out of memory as 71, the audio notice (Sprint 9 Goal 1 Task 6)

docs: R151 -- the release executable keeps -O1: -O2 compressed 4.6 MB worse, ICF bought 0.2 MB; the candidate's zip is 55.7 MB (-15%) and its gate is 3/3 on that exact file

fix(runtime): the Runtime Debugger starts closed -- a player must not find it open over their game (owner 2026-09-20)
